$comment: Garden theme board. Sizes in cells (1 cell = 56 px on the asset sheet), the same units as data/parts.json. Overview: design/themes/garden-board.md. Grass tile (buildFloorTile) and the grass fur shared by the other garden parts. Reference: 02-tile-grass, 11-sheet-tile-grass. Owner: the grass tile session.

image.$comment: The grass tile from the owner's picture (buildFloorTile). The atlas is assets/turnflock/garden/board/tile/grass-tile.webp (cut.py): the top seen from above, then pad rows, then the side's fur strip, all 512 px wide. top: width of the top picture, fur tip to tip is 0.962 of it. wall: the thin body under it. sideRepeat: cells per repeat of the side strip. sideLift: how far the side's normals lean up (the picture's side is already shaded). light: brightness of the material against the game's light. checker: false gives every tile the same picture, as on 01-board-full (owner's choice, 2026-11-24); true tints the alt tile of the checkerboard with altTint.
